_about: Content for the Planning Toolkit page (public/toolkit/). Calendar items come from state documents cited in each row; legal basis labels say whether an item is statute, state policy, contract policy, or guidance. Review each row against its source before each release.

calendar.title: Integrated Plan stakeholder requirements take effect
calendar.detail: County behavioral health departments must engage local stakeholders, including the local health jurisdiction and Medi-Cal managed care plans, in developing the Integrated Plan.
calendar.source: DHCS BHSA County Policy Manual, Chapter 3

calendar.title: Managed care plans contribute to the CHA and CHIP
calendar.detail: Medi-Cal managed care plans meet their Population Needs Assessment requirement by taking part in local health jurisdiction CHA and CHIP processes, and contribute funding or in-kind staff starting in 2025.
calendar.source: CDPH memo to local health jurisdictions, December 26, 2023

calendar.title: Community Reinvestment requirements issued
calendar.detail: Managed care plan Community Reinvestment must be directly informed by the Community Health Assessment, and each plan carries signed attestations from the local public health and county behavioral health directors.

calendar.title: DHCS Local Planning Collaboration Toolkit released
calendar.detail: Guidance for behavioral health departments on working with local health jurisdictions and managed care plans on shared planning, data, and stakeholder engagement.
calendar.source: DHCS BHSA Local Planning Process Collaboration Toolkit

calendar.title: First Integrated Plan final due (FY 2026 to 2029)
calendar.detail: Counties submitted Board of Supervisors approved Integrated Plans. For this first plan, counties could rely on the most recent CHA and CHIP on record.
calendar.source: DHCS BHSA County Policy Manual, Chapter 3

calendar.title: Counties must consider the local health jurisdiction's CHIP
calendar.detail: The Integrated Plan duty to consider the community health improvement plan of the local health jurisdiction becomes operative.

calendar.title: CDPH population-based prevention program for local health jurisdictions begins
calendar.detail: Local health jurisdictions act as Local Prevention Coordinators: they convene required prevention partners and develop or update a Local Suicide Prevention Plan. CDPH budgets $12.0 million per year statewide for fiscal years 2026/27 through 2028/29.
calendar.basis_note: CDPH BHSA Population-Based Prevention Final Plan
calendar.source: CDPH BHSA Population-Based Prevention Final Plan and FAQ

calendar.title: First Community Reinvestment plans due
calendar.detail: Managed care plans submit their first reinvestment plans, with director attestations; new plans are due each September.

calendar.title: Integrated Plan annual update draft due (FY 2027 to 2028)
calendar.detail: The first annual update. Counties still consider the local health jurisdiction's CHIP.
calendar.source: DHCS BHSA County Policy Manual, Chapter 3

calendar.title: Integrated Plan annual update final due
calendar.detail: Final annual update with Board of Supervisors approval.
calendar.source: DHCS BHSA County Policy Manual, Chapter 3

calendar.title: Three-year CHA and CHIP cycle begins for every local health jurisdiction
calendar.detail: CDPH proposed a statutory change requiring all local health jurisdictions to follow one three-year CHA and CHIP cycle starting in 2028. DHCS describes this as pending legislation.
calendar.basis_note: Proposed statute; enacted statute not located as of November 2026
calendar.source: CDPH memo to local health jurisdictions, December 26, 2023

calendar.title: Integrated Plan annual update draft due (FY 2028 to 2029)
calendar.source: DHCS BHSA County Policy Manual, Chapter 3

calendar.title: Prevention coalition folded into the CHA and CHIP
calendar.detail: Local health jurisdictions integrate the prevention convening and coalition process into the CHA and CHIP, working with managed care plans and county behavioral health.
calendar.basis_note: CDPH BHSA Population-Based Prevention Final Plan
calendar.source: CDPH BHSA Population-Based Prevention Final Plan

calendar.title: Synchronized Community Health Assessment due
calendar.detail: First CHA under the shared statewide cycle.
calendar.source: DHCS 2024 MCP and LHJ Collaboration Worksheet

calendar.title: Synchronized CHIP and next Integrated Plan due
calendar.detail: The first CHIP under the shared cycle and the FY 2029 to 2032 Integrated Plan fall on the same date. This is the first full alignment point for the two plans.
calendar.basis_note: CDPH and DHCS policy; Integrated Plan date in statute
calendar.source: DHCS 2024 MCP and LHJ Collaboration Worksheet

calendar.title: Community Reinvestment aligned with the Integrated Plan cycle
calendar.detail: Reinvestment planning moves onto the same cycle as the Integrated Plan.

moves.title: Get your CHIP priorities into the Integrated Plan annual update
moves.do: County behavioral health drafts its first annual update by March 31, 2027, and state law requires it to consider your CHIP. Share your CHA findings and CHIP priorities with behavioral health this winter so the update can cite them.

moves.title: Convene one prevention coalition and make it your CHIP coalition
moves.do: CDPH asks every local health jurisdiction to convene required prevention partners and develop or update a Local Suicide Prevention Plan. Use the same partners and meetings for your CHIP workgroups, so partners come to one table and the suicide prevention plan becomes part of the CHIP.
moves.why: CDPH BHSA Population-Based Prevention Final Plan

moves.title: Shape the next Community Reinvestment plan before it is signed
moves.do: Your managed care plan's next reinvestment plan is due September 1, 2027, and it must be informed by the CHA. The public health and behavioral health directors each sign an attestation. Bring your CHIP priorities to the plan's community advisory process before the draft is final.

moves.title: Run the synchronized CHA with behavioral health and your managed care plan
moves.do: Under state policy, the first CHA on the shared statewide cycle is due December 31, 2028. Plan the partner, status, and context assessments with behavioral health and your managed care plan from the start, so one assessment serves all three plans.
moves.why: CDPH and DHCS policy; statute pending

moves.title: Finish the CHIP and the next Integrated Plan together
moves.do: The CHIP and the FY 2029 to 2032 Integrated Plan are due the same day. Shared priorities and one coalition built in 2027 and 2028 let both plans draw on the same work.
moves.why: CDPH and DHCS policy; Welfare and Institutions Code 5963.02
